notablePrerequisites:
You have at least 4 life.
An Angel or Berserker has entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
description:
Pay 3 life to return Cleaving Reaper from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie token.
Sacrifice the Zombie token to Phyrexian Altar for {W}.
Pay {W} and discard Cleaving Reaper to gain 3 life.
Repeat.
